title: Chapter 235: Trapping Nets Bind Cavalry
content:
Chapter 235: Trapping Nets Bind Cavalry

"Boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers continued to attack, concentrating all their firepower on the charging alien heavy cavalry.

One round of attack killed more than a thousand cavalrymen and injured countless others. This kind of accumulated damage is also very scary.

If you get injured too much, you will always die.

In the second round of attack by the Zerg destroyers, more alien heavy cavalrymen were killed directly, and some heavy cavalrymen who were severely damaged could no longer get up.

Although the alien army was a little far away from the Zerg army, with the charging speed of the alien heavy cavalry, the Zerg destroyers only had five rounds of attack opportunities at most.

At this time, the alien heavy cavalry had not yet rushed into the attack range of the Zerg Hydralisk.

The Zerg flying dragon group avoided the trajectory of the Zerg destroyers and wanted to attack the alien heavy cavalry charging on the ground.

The glittering griffins on the opposite side, who were staring at them eagerly, all rushed over at once. The archers in the ground forces of the alien race who were no longer attacked by the Zerg destroyers below quickly followed up and aimed all their crossbows at the sky.

Wu Qing didn't want to fight the opponent with the Zerg dragons, so he ordered the Zerg dragons to withdraw to the main formation and not compete with the glittering griffins.

The glittering griffins, who had seen the powerful air defense force of the Zerg army, did not dare to chase them.

"Boom boom!"

The third round of concentrated fire attack by the Zerg destroyers fell, and the losses of the alien race heavy cavalry were even greater.

The number of the alien race heavy cavalry who could still charge at the strongest state has dropped to about 150,000. Many wounded soldiers fell behind and could not keep up with the charging formation.

These wounded did not stop, but continued to charge. Their injuries had a certain impact on their combat effectiveness, but their combat effectiveness was still relatively strong.

At this time, the vanguard of the alien race heavy cavalry had already rushed into the attack range of the Zerg hydralisk and stealth spider.

The Zerg stealth spider did not attack for the time being. The powerful armor-piercing spikes of the two-star Zerg Hydralisk shot straight at them at high speed like raindrops.

Sudden attack, a large number of the alien heavy cavalry in the front row fell down instantly.

When the strength is equal, the armor-piercing attack of the Zerg Hydralisk against a single unit is much better than the area-killing attack of the Zerg Destroyer.

The alien heavy cavalry is the purest cavalry unit. Once the momentum is together, it is unstoppable!

The heavy cavalry that fell in front blocked a wave of damage for the cavalry behind, allowing the entire cavalry unit to rush forward for a distance.

Another batch of heavy cavalry fell, and the entire cavalry unit could rush forward for a distance again.

The speed of the alien heavy cavalry is very fast. As long as a certain price is paid, they can quickly rush into the square formation of the Zerg army.

"Stab, stab, stab...!"

Ten thousand two-star and above Zerg stealth spiders began to attack.

All the heavy cavalrymen of the alien race who entered the attack range, whether they were charging in front or behind, were attacked by the terrifying ground spikes that suddenly pierced out from the ground!

The unlucky heavy cavalrymen of the alien race had their horses' chests and abdomens pierced directly by the ground spikes. Those who were injured in vital parts turned into light and disappeared, and the knights on their backs fell to the ground and became infantry.

The ground spikes pierced again and again, and the knights who lost their horses soon followed the footsteps of their mounts.

The heavy cavalrymen with good luck, whose defenses were not pierced by the ground spikes, would also be pushed into the air, disrupting the rhythm of the charge, and their defenses were almost ineffective.

The ground spike attack of the Zerg stealth spider greatly increased the difficulty of the charge of the heavy cavalry of the alien race. This attack had a good killing effect on heavy arms such as the heavy cavalry of the alien race.

"Boom boom...!"

The fourth round of attack by the Zerg destroyer arrived.

Under the combined attack of the frontal armor-piercing attack of the Zerg Hydralisk, the underground spike attack of the Zerg Stealth Spider, and the aerial explosion attack of the Zerg Destroyer, the heavy cavalry of the alien race, which has always been invincible, suffered heavy casualties.

"I will lead the charge myself! To protect the light! We must rush forward!"

Faced with this situation, a powerful knight personally led the most elite heavy cavalry of the alien race and rushed to the front.

The light attribute energy on their bodies was as rich as substance, as if they were wearing another snow-white light armor.

This cavalry of more than a thousand people, with five-star knights as the spearhead, four-star knights as the backbone, and three-star knights as members, bravely moved forward against the attacks of the Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Stealth Spider!

Their outermost light armor has extremely strong defensive capabilities, and armor-piercing spikes and armor-piercing ground spikes can't do anything to them.

A small number of four-star and three-star Zerg Hydralisks and Stealth Spiders can't break this layer of defense for a while.

"This should be a powerful defensive magic. It can't be broken at once, it can only be consumed!"

"It's time for the Zerg Queen to show her skills in front of people!"

Wu Qing and other powerful alien heavy cavalry team rushed into the range of the Zerg cockroaches. When victory seemed to be in sight, they ordered the Zerg Queen to take action.

The Zerg Queen has a total of four abilities. In addition to the egg laying, parasitic control and parasitic reconnaissance used before, there is also an ability of trapping.

The Zerg Queen flew out of the Zerg flying dragon group, flew to a position not far from the charging alien army, and sprayed a ball of thick green mucus from her terrifying mouthparts.

This kind of attack at a distance hides the true range of their attack.

This ball of thick green mucus flew over the sky above the charging alien heavy cavalry, grew in the wind, and instantly turned into a giant net, netting the charging heavy cavalry below.

Thousands of charging alien heavy cavalry were still separated by a certain distance from each other. Such a large area was covered by several nets at once.

The trapping net launched by the Zerg Queen was very magical. Once the green net stuck to the alien heavy cavalry with strong defensive capabilities, it ignored the defense and directly restricted the movements of the heavy cavalry and war horses!

A large part of the trapping net fell to the ground, just like taking root, further restricting the actions of the trapped target.

But the strength of the alien heavy cavalry leading the charge was indeed strong. They all had powerful magic skills, and their bodies were flashing with white light. Under the powerful restriction of the trapping net, they could still maintain a certain charging speed!

"Boom boom!"

Accompanied by the attack of the Zerg Destroyer, the three- and four-star Zerg Hydralisks in the Zerg army sprayed a wave of Zerg biological decomposition liquid.

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid sprayed by the high-star Zerg Hydralisks has a strong decomposition characteristic and can quickly consume the divine blessing, energy and physical defense of the enemy.

Several Zerg queens sprayed trapping nets to strengthen the restriction of more than a thousand alien heavy cavalry in front. Other Zerg queens also sprayed trapping nets to the main force of heavy cavalry charging behind.

The normal-strength alien heavy cavalry was caught in the trapping nets sprayed by the four-star Zerg queens. Their movements were greatly restricted and they rushed forward with all their strength, and their speed was reduced to the extreme.

This gave the Zerg army the opportunity to attack calmly.

In addition to Zerg Destroyers, Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Stealth Spiders, some Zerg cockroaches can also attack.

The time when the Zerg Queen made her move was to put the vanguard of the Alien Heavy Cavalry into the attack range of the Zerg Cockroaches.

The corrosive high-temperature flames "whoosh" sprayed on the Alien Heavy Cavalry, causing terrible damage and consuming all kinds of energy defenses on them.

The combination of explosion, flame, armor-piercing spikes, armor-piercing ground spikes, strong corrosion and strong decomposition was too terrible. Facing this level of attack damage, even the five-star Alien Heavy Cavalry felt exhausted.

"Is this the combat power of the Zerg army!?"

"Such a powerful alien heavy cavalry unit can't even charge!"

"That green net is too scary! Even the five-star knights are bound!"

"This is really the nemesis of the cavalry!"

"Except for the melee units that drilled into the ground, almost all other units of the Zerg army have taken action. Each of them is the top of the same type of units. It's really not simple!"

"Super long-range, long-range, medium-range and close combat, there are corresponding units, plus flying units in the air and various auxiliary combat units, the unit configuration of this Zerg army really has no shortcomings!"

"As long as the alien heavy cavalry unit is eliminated, victory will be in sight in today's battle!"

"..."

The performance of the Zerg army has won everyone's recognition.

The trapping net sprayed by the Zerg Queen is not affected by various attacks and has been firmly restricting and restraining the alien heavy cavalry unit.

Although the alien heavy cavalry could not be completely restrained in place, their speed of movement was greatly reduced, making them live targets for the various arms of the Zerg army.

The front-line alien heavy cavalry finally suffered casualties. The rich light attribute energy on their bodies was exhausted. The pure iron armor and human flesh, under such a fierce attack by the Zerg army, lasted for a moment and then turned into light and disappeared.

The troops behind the alien heavy cavalry were blocked by the restricted cavalry in front and could no longer charge forward. They were blocked in the back and continued to withstand the attacks of the Zerg destroyers.

On the contrary, the alien soldiers and infantry phalanxes following the heavy cavalry gradually caught up.

Observing that the heavy cavalry's attack was blocked, the alien army also sent the light griffins in the air to cooperate with the ground troops to quickly advance towards the Zerg army to rescue the heavy cavalry in front.

The Zerg Destroyers' attack began to extend to the rear of the alien heavy cavalry units, trying to block the rapid advance of the alien army's infantry.
